text_block_list.text:
One day, with the debut race fast 
approaching—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be meddlesome of me, 
but I felt it best to inform you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Satono-san's debut race is 
going to draw even more attention, 
wouldn't you say?

"Debut Race with a Total of 500 Million 
RKST Points!!" That sensational headline 
danced across the magazine Mejiro McQueen 
held out.
『Rookie Knowledge, Stats, and Talent』

"RKST points are evaluation scores for 
pre-debut Umamusume, announced every 
July."

A numerical overall rating analyzing an 
Umamusume's abilities, evaluated by 
retired Trainers, Umamusume critics, and 
other experts.

With an overwhelming appraisal of 230 
million points among historical records, 
Satono Diamond drew massive attention even 
before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume rated with even higher points 
than Satono-san is running in the same 
debut race, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It looks like many other highly rated 
Umamusume are gathering as well— 
supposedly totaling over 500 million 
points.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even if interest grows even further, I'm 
sure it won't be a problem for someone 
like Satono-san, but...
choice_data_list: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.

text_block_list.text:
Even though Satono Diamond has her act 
together, it's still her debut race. It 
never hurts to be overly cautious and 
attentive.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When you attract a lot of 
attention... all sorts of opinions will 
fly around.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I look forward to working with 
you again today!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hey, Satono Diamond is here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...There seem to be quite a lot of 
reporters here today.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond-san, would you mind if we 
asked you a few questions?
choice_data_list: I'm about to go train, so...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I don't mind. If it's only for a 
little while, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Your debut race 
turned into a showdown between top-tier 
Umamusume; could you share your thoughts 
going into it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, so that is what you are called.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I am grateful for the attention. I will 
make sure my debut race lives up to those 
expectations."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Do you feel any pressure?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That goes for everyone, after all.

Satono Diamond answers the questions 
smoothly. She didn't seem particularly 
concerned about the high-stakes point 
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Phew... Sorry to keep you, I'm all done.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehe, I got a little thirsty.
choice_data_list: Shall we ask them to limit press access?

text_block_list.text:
This is a critical period leading up to 
her debut race. If I ask Tazuna-san, she 
should be able to arrange things so 
excessive media coverage is kept in check.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. Giving interviews is part 
of an Umamusume's duty, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If people get hyped up for my debut race, 
I'm honestly grateful for it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure everyone in the Satono family 
must be overjoyed."
choice_data_list: Is all the attention becoming a burden?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I am quite used to it. I have been 
the center of attention in the Satono 
family ever since I was small, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
At the occasional party, I'd get bombarded 
with questions like: "What's your time 
right now?" or "Are you heading to Tracen 
Academy?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My relatives and fellow Umamusume around 
my age were so jealous of me, complaining 
that it wasn't fair how much I was doted 
on♪

There wasn't a trace of nervousness about 
her. It seems she truly is accustomed to 
this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... is this actually a bother 
for you, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If it will interfere with your training, 
please feel free to decline the interview.
choice_data_list:
If you're okay with me, then there's no 
problem...!

If you're okay with it, then it's no 
problem...!

text_block_list.text:
"She ended up worrying about me instead. 
If she isn't bothered by it, it's probably 
best if I don't overthink things either."
And then, the day of the debut race—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —It's finally time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just thinking that my Twinkle Series 
is finally about to begin...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I feel goosebumps rising all over my 
skin...!

Completely free of any nerves, Satono 
Diamond is brimming with a good, focused 
energy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Satono Diamond, heading out!
